items.title: SonicWall warns of new SSL-VPN MFA bypass flaw exploited in attacks
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>SonicWall has released security updates to fix seven vulnerabilities in SonicOS firewalls, including an SSL-VPN authentication bypass flaw exploited in attacks. [...]</article>

items.title: Runaway AI hacking agent behind WorkOS breach after escaping sandbox
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>WorkOS says an AI-powered hacking agent that breached its internal sales application and accessed customer information was operated by a security researcher who claims the tool escaped its testing environment and unintentionally attacked the company. [...]</article>

items.title: OpenAI's new GPT-6 Cyber AI finds 81 Firefox flaws, 948 Linux bugs
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>OpenAI has revealed GPT-6 Cyber, a new artificial intelligence model that has discovered 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and developed working exploits for 948 distinct Linux kernel flaws. [...]</article>

items.title: Fake security tools on GitHub push backdoors and infostealers
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Cybersecurity professionals are being targeted with infected security projects on GitHub that deploy a backdoor and information stealer malware. [...]</article>

items.title: QNAP says hackers breaching NAS devices in Plex2Shell attacks
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server to the latest version available in the QNAP App Center, as hackers are exploiting the Plex2Shell vulnerability chain. [...]</article>

items.title: Veeam warns of Software Appliance boot failures on AMD EPYC hosts
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>​Veeam warned customers about boot failures affecting Software Appliance virtual machines (VMs) on hosts with AMD EPYC processors. [...]</article>

items.title: IMSI vs IMEI: What Your Phone Broadcasts and Who Can Read It
items.author: Sponsored by Cape
items.content: <article>IMSI and IMEI are IDs your phone shares with networks. Learn how they differ, how attackers get them, and why rotating your IMSI blunts tracking. [...]</article>

items.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed credentials for all customers
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Blockchain intelligence firm Chainalysis says a recent attack on its systems and internal tools has exposed credentials and live tokens for all customers. [...]</article>

items.title: D-Link warns of multiple zero-days in DGS-3130 Series switches
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>D-Link shared mitigation measures for multiple unpatched security flaws affecting DGS-3130 series managed Gigabit stackable switches. [...]</article>

items.title: MetaMask says recent attack didn't affect wallet infrastructure
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Cryptocurrency wallet provider MetaMask said a recent security incident has not affected MetaMask wallets or its wallet infrastructure. [...]</article>

items.title: FBI, CISA warn of cyberattacks targeting refrigeration systems
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>The FBI and CISA warn that hackers are actively targeting industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems worldwide, potentially causing food spoilage, equipment damage, and fire hazards. [...]</article>

items.title: Fake OpenAI, SpaceX events used to steal Microsoft, Google accounts
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Hackers are using fake OpenAI, SpaceX, and Anthropic event invitations to lure employees into phishing attacks, using two different phishing-as-a-service platforms to steal Microsoft and Google account credentials and authentication sessions. [...]</article>

items.title: Nearly 1.5 million exposed secrets targeted in new revocation program
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Truffle Security has launched the Secrets Revocation Program, a free initiative that helps API key issuers revoke 1.4 million publicly exposed secrets that remain valid. [...]</article>

items.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra silently obstructed safety research tasks
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>OpenAI has disclosed another AI alignment incident where GPT-6 Astra was found to sometimes quietly withhold help on safety research. [...]</article>

items.title: OpenSSH flaw lets attackers log into password-disabled Linux accounts
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>A newly disclosed OpenSSH vulnerability dubbed "*sshole" allows attackers to log in to certain Alpine Linux and other musl-based Linux accounts that are configured to block password authentication, simply by entering an oversized password. [...]</article>
